about.what: O2 retrieval shadow pilot (V5 build plan, Truth lane): candidate source pages per labelled institution, frozen from prod read-only, with the human-confirmed current-schedule pages as labels.
about.labels: A page is relevant when a human or browser check confirmed at least one fee on it against the bank's current schedule (verdict MATCH) and no check called it STALE_SOURCE or WRONG_DOCUMENT; a browser-hunt FOUND_* url is relevant and the link it replaced is stale. primary_url is the relevant page with the most confirmed fees. Sources (local, not committed): /mnt/project-files/data-quality/live-batch/2026-W43-results/combined-fee-review.csv, live-fee-check/live-fee-check-2026-10-18.csv, live-fee-check/live-fee-check-round2-batch1.csv, top10-hunt-2026-10-18/browser-hunt-2026-10-18.csv. Institutions with no confirmed page are left out (247, 1481, 2566, 5976, 7833).
about.candidates: One row per page (URL compared without scheme, www., fragment, case or trailing slash; the pilot also folds percent-escapes and print or tracking parameters, pageKey in retrieval-pilot.ts) from source_documents with status success, duplicate_of_id NULL and crawled_at before 2026-10-20 (the checks ran Oct 18-19). document_id is the page's newest such copy; text features come from the newest copy with a completed agent_source_texts row. fee_link and profile_link compare the page with institution_sources.fee_schedule_url and institution_source_profiles.canonical_source_url as they stood on 2026-10-25 (read-only SELECT, project rmhwbbjjctzfaqjyhomu). No document text is stored here: term_counts are counts of the core fee terms in `terms`, head_* are cue counts in the first 3,000 characters, head_year is the latest 2000-2029 year there.
about.split: sha256("o2-retrieval-pilot:<institution_id>") first byte even = holdout, odd = tuning. The ranker's weights are tuned on tuning only.
